name: Water Intake
summary: Log the water and drinks you have each day on the web, desktop, or iPhone, keep a daily goal and streak, and share every glass with Apple Health, encrypted at rest under your own account's key.

screenshots.alt: Water Intake page with a glass filling toward a 2 litre goal, quick add buttons, today's drinks, and a 30-day chart

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

config.title: Water
config.description: Log glasses of water and other drinks, keep a daily goal, and sync with Apple Health.
